A '''circuit breaker''',<ref name="EGTD" /> also known as a '''shutdown switch''',<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component. It served as a master on/off switch for the droid. The circuit breaker for the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] was located at the back of its neck. A multiposition circuit breaker was located on the back face of [[Lowbacca]]'s [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] [[M-TD]].<ref name="EGTD" />
